WITH q3_users AS (  -- one row per user who signed up in July to September 2025
  SELECT user_id, visitor_id
  FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00'
),
numbered AS (  -- one row per session of those users, numbered from the earliest
  SELECT u.user_id, se.landing_page,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.user_id ORDER BY se.session_start, se.session_id) AS session_no
  FROM q3_users u
  JOIN sessions se ON se.visitor_id = u.visitor_id
),
payers AS (  -- one row per user with a payment that was not refunded
  SELECT DISTINCT su.user_id
  FROM subscriptions su
  JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = su.subscription_id
  WHERE NOT p.refunded
)
SELECT n.landing_page,
       COUNT(*) AS new_users,
       COUNT(pa.user_id) AS paying_users,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(pa.user_id) / COUNT(*), 1) AS paying_pct
FROM numbered n
LEFT JOIN payers pa ON pa.user_id = n.user_id
WHERE n.session_no = 1
GROUP BY n.landing_page
ORDER BY new_users DESC, n.landing_page

SELECT f.landing_page,
       COUNT(*) AS new_users,
       SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions su JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = su.subscription_id
                             WHERE su.user_id = f.user_id AND p.refunded = false) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paying_users,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions su JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = su.subscription_id
                                           WHERE su.user_id = f.user_id AND p.refunded = false) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS paying_pct
FROM (
  -- one row per session of a user who signed up in July to September 2025, numbered from the earliest
  SELECT g.user_id, se.landing_page,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY g.user_id ORDER BY se.session_start ASC, se.session_id ASC) AS session_no
  FROM signups AS g
  JOIN sessions AS se ON se.visitor_id = g.visitor_id
  WHERE CAST(g.signup_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'
) AS f
WHERE f.session_no = 1
GROUP BY f.landing_page
ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1

WITH q3_users AS (  -- one row per user who signed up in July to September 2025
  SELECT user_id, visitor_id
  FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00' AND signup_ts < '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00'
),
first_start AS (  -- one row per user with a session: the earliest session_start
  SELECT u.user_id, MIN(se.session_start) AS first_start
  FROM q3_users u
  JOIN sessions se ON se.visitor_id = u.visitor_id
  GROUP BY u.user_id
),
first_session AS (  -- one row per user: the lowest session_id among the sessions at that earliest start
  SELECT f.user_id, MIN(se.session_id) AS session_id
  FROM first_start f
  JOIN q3_users u ON u.user_id = f.user_id
  JOIN sessions se ON se.visitor_id = u.visitor_id AND se.session_start = f.first_start
  GROUP BY f.user_id
),
payers AS (  -- one row per user with a payment that was not refunded
  SELECT su.user_id
  FROM subscriptions su
  JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = su.subscription_id
  WHERE p.refunded = false
  GROUP BY su.user_id
)
SELECT se.landing_page,
       COUNT(fs.user_id) AS new_users,
       COUNT(pa.user_id) AS paying_users,
       ROUND(COUNT(pa.user_id) * 100.0 / COUNT(fs.user_id), 1) AS paying_pct
FROM first_session fs
JOIN sessions se ON se.session_id = fs.session_id
LEFT JOIN payers pa ON pa.user_id = fs.user_id
GROUP BY se.landing_page
ORDER BY new_users DESC, se.landing_page ASC

solver.query:
WITH u AS (
  SELECT user_id, visitor_id FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00' AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00'
), fs AS (
  SELECT u.user_id, s.landing_page,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.user_id ORDER BY s.session_start ASC, s.session_id ASC) AS rn
  FROM u JOIN sessions s ON s.visitor_id = u.visitor_id
), pay AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.user_id
  FROM subscriptions s JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
  WHERE p.refunded = false
)
SELECT fs.landing_page,
       COUNT(*) AS new_users,
       COUNT(pay.user_id) AS paying_users,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(pay.user_id) / COUNT(*), 1) AS paying_pct
FROM fs LEFT JOIN pay ON pay.user_id = fs.user_id
WHERE fs.rn = 1
GROUP BY fs.landing_page
ORDER BY new_users DESC, landing_page ASC
